definitions.explanation: The style or design of written or printed characters.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{字体|じたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦にくい→〜にくい：02005_nikui⟧。
examples.english: This font is hard to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明朝体|みんちょうたい}→明朝体：22715_minchoutai⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{字体|じたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The Mincho typeface is often used.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{字体|じたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a business card with a new font.

notes:
{字体|じたい} refers to the visual style of characters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {字体|じたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ (to change the font)
- ⟦{明朝体|みんちょうたい}→明朝体：22715_minchoutai⟧ (Mincho typeface - serif)
- ⟦ゴシック→ゴシック：noentry⟧⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (Gothic typeface - sans-serif)
- ⟦{楷書体|かいしょたい}→楷書体：noentry⟧ (standard script style)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {字体|じたい}: font/typeface (character style)
- ⟦フォント→フォント：20915_fonto⟧: font (borrowed from English, common in computing)
- ⟦{書体|しょたい}→書体：13024_shotai⟧: typeface, writing style

WATCH OUT:
- {字体|じたい}: font, typeface
- ⟦{辞退|じたい}→辞退：03338_jitai⟧: refusal, declining
